name: Do I need to install a subfloor or moisture barrier over concrete before flooring?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to install a subfloor or moisture barrier over concrete before flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: You do not always need a full subfloor system, but a moisture barrier is essential over bare concrete. Floating vinyl planks often come with attached acoustic and thermal pads, requiring only a simple 6-mil poly vapor barrier over the slab to block ground dampness. However, if your basement feels particularly cold or damp, installing an engineered subfloor panel system with a raised vapor gap creates a warmer, cushioned surface. Direct-glue installations or tile work require specific waterproof membranes rather than floating plywood subfloors.
acceptedAnswer.description: A vapor barrier is almost always necessary to block concrete moisture, but a full raised subfloor panel system is optional based on comfort goals.
